messages:
maria: Onboarding SableHyena-lite (13B-ish). Ran int4 conversion and smoke evals — short-context looks fine but longctx summarization test degrades badly after ~1k tokens. Anyone seen token drift / kvcache misfetchs with this family?
jasper: I ran a quick end-to-end and saw repetition + context dropoff around the 1024->1536 boundary. My gut says either kvcache address shift or vocab normalizer mismatch.
ev an: :eyes: can you paste a snippet of tokenizer output around the boundary? may be a hidden whitespace / ZWJ issue.
maria: Pasted a quick extract — looks like some tokens decode to an odd non-breaking space sequence that our tokenizer normalizer turns into a different token id.
```
# decode around token boundary (simplified)
['This', 'Ġis', 'Ġa', 'Ġtest', 'Ġ ', 'word', 'Ġthat', 'Ġcontinues']
# token ids: [12, 45, 9, 78, 9876, 34, 56, 77]
```
jasper: That   (NBSP) / ZWJ handling is classic legacy-BPE behavior — SableHyena's tokenizer preserves nonstandard whitespace sequences, while our pipeline runs NFKC and collapses them. If decode(ids) != normalize(token_string) then later tokens shift when reconstructing cached KV entries.
ci-bot: CI run: conversion pipeline (quant-int4) passed unit checks, e2e inference smoke failed on longctx summarization (failed tests: summarizer_longctx_2k).
zhen: Try converting with preserve_whitespace flag and run with a small rotary_phase_scale tweak — we had luck with a similar headwise freq mismatch on another model. Example:
```
redwood-cli model convert --from sablehyena --quant=int4 --preserve_whitespace=true --out /tmp/sablehyena-int4
# then runtime config override
model.config.rotary_phase_scale = 0.985
```
ashley: Also consider adding a token-map remapping step during conversion to canonicalize ZWJ/NBSP to a single codepoint that the runtime expects. That avoids downstream kvcache address mismatches.
maria: Ran conversion with --preserve_whitespace=true and rotary_phase_scale=0.985. Quick numbers: PPL@512=12.3, @1024=13.1, @2048=18.3 (was ~40 before). qna_exact_match went from 78->89 after the change.
jasper: Nice. Can you drop the exact token-level diff for the failing sample to confirm roundtrip? Also I'll open a small PR to add a unit test: encode->decode roundtrip for a 2k token seed that includes NBSP/ZWJ variants.
ev an: We should also run a perf sweep to check int4 latency/throughput vs fp16 on dedicated nodes — want to make sure cost savings aren't offset by repeated attention stalls due to kvcache misses. I'll schedule a microbenchmark (throughput, p50/p99 latency) after the fix.
maria: Agree. I'll create a tracking ticket with follow-ups: 1) tokenizer normalizer change + tests, 2) default conversion flag to preserve_whitespace for legacy vocabs, 3) add >1024 token roundtrip regression, 4) perf sweep int4 vs fp16. Assigning to @jasper/@zhen/@evan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
